profile.headline: Experienced software and database developer with a strong record of delivering solutions in the information technology and services industry.
profile.summary: Software developer with expertise in Python, C#, .NET, ASP.NET, Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL Server, and agentic AI solutions. Proven ability to collaborate within agile teams and apply strong problem-solving skills to enhance operational efficiency. Track record of delivering high-quality software solutions that meet business needs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed conversational AI agent using Python, LangGraph, FastAPI, and Streamlit for travel booking requests.
•	Integrated OpenAI GPT-4.1 API to handle message processing efficiently.
•	Utilized commercial APIs to retrieve flight and hotel data for seamless user interaction.
•	Implemented email verification codes through emailing API to enhance user authentication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed AI agents using Python, LangGraph, and Streamlit for a custom AI flight and hotel search system. Created Restful API using FastApi for Streamlit user interface (UI) and AI Agent communication via JSON. Integrated OpenAI GPT-4.1 API to process AI agent message requests and responses efficiently. Utilized commercial API’s and modules to retrieve flight and hotel data for seamless user interaction. Implemented an email verification module to strength user authentication and security. Deploy project solution as Docker container(s) via Docker Desktop.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, deployed, and supported an ASP.NET Web Forms applications and API services for a user base of 3,000+, improving system stability and performance using C#.NET, HTML, JavaScript, IIS, MySQL, and Oracle RDBMS.
•	Implemented a high-throughput message streaming architecture using Apache Kafka, enabling the reliable processing of over 17 million JSON messages annually through a multi-threaded C# API, significantly enhancing system scalability.
•	Engineered a Python-based data pipeline using Pandas to streamline ad-hoc reporting and automate data import/export with MS Excel, reducing data handling time by over 40%.
•	Automated key client workflows with UIPath RPA, cutting manual processing time by 60% and improving operational efficiency across departments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained ASP.NET web applications and APIs for 3,000+ users, improving stability and performance using C#, JavaScript, Oracle, IIS, and AWS. Built a scalable, high-throughput streaming system using Apache Kafka and a multi-threaded C# .NET API, enabling reliable processing of 17 million JSON messages annually. Created tables, views, triggers, stored procedures, SQL/T-SQL, and PL-SQL within an Oracle, RDMS environment. Engineered a Python Pandas data pipeline to automate Excel processing and reporting, reducing data error resolution time by 40%. positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer/Systems Analyst
positions.description:
